body: This 2025 Sprinter AWD 170 build in our El Capitan Tier is built for long road trips, camping, and comfortable travel. With 800Ah Battle Born lithium power, solar, roof A/C, diesel heat, a 33 gallon water system, tiled indoor shower, full kitchen, Starlink, queen bed, exterior storage, and upgraded adventure gear, it’s designed to feel comfortable while still being ready for the road.
